dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... Looks like a Ratnik's gravestone. Could it be from those Ratniki we saw in the canyon?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: They keep flickering in and out, showing up one moment and vanishing the next...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, Paimon still doesn't get what's going on. Let's ask around in Piramida next time! Maybe someone there knows about this.

dialogues.speaker: Patolichev
dialogues.text: Oh, greetings. I'm Patolichev, quartermaster of the Lightkeepers. How can I help you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you Patolichev of the Frostgale Steeds?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Frostgale Steeds... Ah, you mean those strange shadows we saw earlier...

dialogues.speaker: Patolichev
dialogues.text: Yes, that was the squad I once served with. The Frostgale Steeds... It's been a long time since I've heard that name. I never thought I'd hear it from someone else's mouth... May I ask how you...?

choices.text: We've been to the foot of Kipumaki Cliff before.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yep! And we took care of the Wild Hunt that was causing trouble there!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We even saw the Ratniki from the Frostgale Steeds... their shadows still lingering from their fight against the Wild Hunt...

response.speaker: Patolichev
response.text: I can't believe it was real...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Of course it was! We saw it with our own eyes!

response.speaker: Patolichev
response.text: Ah... Over the years, people have told me from time to time of how they've seen the figures of my fallen comrades at Kipumaki Cliff. That's why even now, I still go there often... and tend to their graves while I'm there.

response.speaker: Patolichev
response.text: But not once... not even once, have I ever seen them myself. It's been so long... I thought those stories were just kind lies to comfort me.

response.speaker: Patolichev
response.text: And yet you truly saw them... Why is it that whenever I go, they never show themselves to me?

choices.text: Maybe... the time just hasn't come yet.

response.speaker: Patolichev
response.text: Perhaps... Still, knowing they're really there, even as mere fleeting shadows or memories, is enough for me.

response.speaker: Patolichev
response.text: #In any case, thank you, {M#Sir}{F#Lady}, thank you for being willing to tell me. This means a lot to me.

response.speaker: Patolichev
response.text: It's thanks to them that I can still stand here today. And yet... how I wish I could stand with them once more at the foot of Kipumaki Cliff, fighting shoulder to shoulder again.

response.speaker: Patolichev
response.text: ...One day. One day, I'm sure I'll meet them again.

choices.text: Maybe they just don't want you to recall the pain...

response.speaker: Patolichev
response.text: *sigh* Pain? No... Those final days, standing side by side with them to the very end... how could that ever be painful?

choices.text: We saw the Ratniki of the Frostgale Steeds...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yes... and even if only their shadows remain, those shadows still show them locked in battle with the Wild Hunt...
